guidance: Optimize for shared understanding, not a detailed plan. Make the why crisp, milestones outcome-based, and risks actionable. Avoid status-report filler and invented dates when unknown—mark unknowns clearly.

outline.title: Objective
outline.guidance: Align on why this initiative exists and who is involved.

children.title: The Why
children.guidance: Primary business or product goal for doing this now.

children.title: Stakeholders
children.guidance: Who is involved, who decides, and who must stay informed. Use a short bullet list or table (Name / Role / Involvement).

outline.title: Milestones
outline.guidance: Group outcome-based phases for the initiative.

children.title: Phase
children.guidance: Title each instance with the phase or milestone name, not "Phase".

children.title: Deliverables
children.guidance: What is produced in this phase.

children.title: Target Timeline
children.guidance: Rough completion expectation. Say "TBD" rather than inventing dates.

outline.title: Risks & Unknowns
outline.guidance: Surface blockers early with owners for mitigation.

children.title: Risk
children.guidance: Title each instance with the risk itself, not "Risk".

children.title: Impact
children.guidance: What could go wrong or block the project.

children.title: Mitigation
children.guidance: How the team will de-risk or handle it.
